reranker.input: pairs of raw user query and D_full_enriched payload document

score_contract.score: alias of reranker_score for the final pipeline
score_contract.dense_rank: rank in the Qdrant candidate list

acceptance_checks: Every final movie is a member of the corresponding dense candidate pool.
Ranks are contiguous and deterministic; reranker ties preserve dense order.
Structured filters are applied before candidate retrieval and cannot be undone by reranking.
NDCG@10 is compared with the frozen dense baseline using the same relevance judgments.
Expected query/system runs with zero retrieved items are scored as empty runs instead of being omitted.
New query-document pairs from the maximum candidate pool are manually judged before definitive metrics are computed.
Candidate Recall@N and latency are reported for every evaluated pool size.
A single candidate pool size is selected before the MCP interface is frozen.
open_evaluation_items: Complete relevance judgments for every test query; the previous metric output covered 9 of 10 queries.
Run the real model and decide whether its quality gain justifies added latency.
Select one candidate_pool_size using quality, per-query deltas and latency.
